title: Partial execution — manual OCR ground truth, isolated concurrency, and full-universe serving inventory remain

checks.name: visual-OCR candidate audit by section
checks.method: Fully page the selected extraction view, fetch exact selected Tier 4 artifact IDs, count visual_ocr_pages and section-key presence.
checks.exclusions: No section-specific human ground truth; section presence is not recall.
checks.result: 33 selected Tier 4 documents record visual OCR pages. Section value/document distributions were captured, but null-to-visual-candidate recall was not measurable.
checks.confidence: high for use counts; low for recall

checks.name: Tier 4 corpus/fallback distribution
checks.method: Fetch every selected Tier 4 base/fallback artifact by exact ID and compute stored/merged field-count and section distributions.
checks.exclusions: Non-selected historical Tier 4 artifacts.
checks.result: Selected Tier 4 count 3,485; merged fields p50 215, p95 571, range 0–748. The selected view chose no fallback artifacts and added zero fields.

checks.name: admissions withholding and friendly API behavior
checks.method: Page all school_browser_rows, apply the public-data.ts incoherent-count predicate, and inspect friendly-field suppression behavior statically.
checks.exclusions: Only applied/admitted/enrolled_first_year friendly facts.
checks.result: Five rows are incoherent; 15 non-null values are withheld by the friendly API with low_confidence_extract while raw browser rows remain queryable.

checks.name: per-document artifact-to-projection freshness
checks.method: Define extracted/selected/canonical-year>=2024 eligibility, compare per-document projection presence and updated_at against selected artifact created_at, then inspect selector differences.
checks.exclusions: Identity uses producer/version/schema proxies because projections omit artifact_id/source_sha256; SQL selected view lacks one Python selector rule.
checks.result: Eight expected browser documents and 12 expected cds_fields documents are missing; three failed documents remain unexpectedly. No present projection updated before its selected artifact. Two proxy identity mismatches reduce to one likely stale selection and one expected unusable-Tier-2 divergence.
checks.unfinished_reason: Projection rows lack selected artifact identity, so byte-exact freshness cannot be proved.

checks.name: year identity and source-byte sample
checks.method: Hash-sample 100 current PDF source artifacts, download with a 50 MiB cap, verify bytes against artifact/document hashes, and run the worker byte-year detector.
checks.exclusions: The byte detector found no year in 16 files; those are explicit unknowns, not matches.
checks.result: 100/100 byte-confirmed PDFs completed; artifact hash mismatches 0; byte-year versus detected_year mismatches 0 where both exist; document source_sha256 mismatches 2 while artifact SHA still matched bytes.

checks.name: historical-schema leakage
checks.method: Stratify selected Tier 4 artifacts by canonical year, source format, producer version, schema version, and year-disagreement flag; inspect projector schema-preference code.
checks.exclusions: 2,963 selected Tier 4 documents have schema_version=unknown and cannot enter the explicit-schema denominator.
checks.result: 122 of 522 explicit-schema Tier 4 selections have canonical year unequal to schema version, mostly old documents cleaned against 2025–26. This measures proxy-schema use, not demonstrated wrong values; canonical-year preference now exists in the projector.
checks.unfinished_reason: Needs value-level review to distinguish intended historical proxying from harmful leakage.

checks.name: synthesized 2023–24 schema validation
checks.method: Strictly page selected base_schema_version=2023-24 results, fetch the exact three artifacts, and compare their value-key union with 1,053 canonical schema IDs.
checks.exclusions: Only three current selected artifacts use this schema; a zero hit is not evidence that a field is invalid.
checks.result: 691 schema IDs have a hit, 362 have zero hits, and 27 observed keys fall outside the schema. Outside-key hit counts are retained for review.
checks.confidence: high for current selected corpus; low for schema-retirement inference

checks.name: probe-outcome taxonomy
checks.method: Page all archive_queue rows and tabulate persisted last_outcome/status; separately run a real-resolver deterministic N=20 reprobe.
checks.exclusions: Persisted outcomes do not retain a full Box/Drive/SharePoint/WAF/JS-only/Tableau host-family classification.
checks.result: Full paging finds 2,848 no_pdfs_found rows across 1,356 schools. The old first-page-only query reproduces exactly 240. Completed/null outcome is 2,470/10,945 (22.57%), not 'mostly null.'
checks.unfinished_reason: Original host-family reclassification is not derivable from persisted rows alone.

checks.name: section-package completeness
checks.method: Count persisted source_part artifacts by document and assert every persisted package has at least two parts; inspect resolver selection rules.
checks.exclusions: Candidates never selected or persisted are unobservable; package notes query exceeded the API statement timeout and was excluded.
checks.result: Five documents preserve 378 source_part artifacts; all five have at least two parts. This cannot prove that every discoverable multi-part bundle was complete.
checks.confidence: high for persisted packages; low for discovery recall
checks.unfinished_reason: Resolver candidate completeness needs captured discovery manifests.

checks.name: attempt ledger and enqueue/concurrency invariant
checks.method: Page all post-ledger archive_queue_attempts and compute terminal-state duration/timeout metrics; defer concurrent enqueue mutation to an isolated database.
checks.exclusions: Concurrent enqueue invariant was not exercised against production.
checks.result: All 4,795 attempts are terminal; p50 866 ms, p95 32,060.2 ms, max 1,321,495 ms; 111 timed out (2.315%).
checks.confidence: high for ledger; none for concurrency exercise
checks.unfinished_reason: Requires isolated local/test database concurrency test.

checks.name: pipeline freshness measurements/SLO proposal
checks.method: Measure discovered-to-selected and selected-to-browser updated_at lags on the eligible CDS denominator; inspect scheduled workflows and IPEDS cache metadata controls.
checks.exclusions: No reliable ipeds_raw_rows→facts→cache refresh timestamp chain is exposed.
checks.result: CDS discovered→selected p50 20.6 days/p95 63.3 days; selected→browser updated p50 1.15 s/p95 5.03 days. Proposed initial SLO: 95% of selected current-year documents projected within 24 h and zero selected rows older than 7 d; instrument IPEDS cache timestamps before setting its SLO.
checks.confidence: high for CDS measurement; proposal only for thresholds
checks.unfinished_reason: IPEDS cache stage lacks auditable refresh timestamps.

checks.name: direct ipeds_facts reader inventory
checks.method: Repository-wide call-site inventory, excluding generated output and classifying runtime serving, bounded tools, writer validation, tests, and documentation.
checks.query_script_identifier: static grep inventory recorded in static-contracts.json
checks.exclusions: Documentation examples, tests, and the loader's writer path are separately classified.
checks.result: The one public school-page runtime reader uses school_facts_unified; no runtime school-page reader directly queries ipeds_facts. Direct reads are bounded audit/reconciliation/recipe/load-validation paths plus documented historical API examples.

checks.name: loaded-but-unserved institution inventory
checks.method: Join distinct reporters in the FY2020–FY2024 six-field endowment slice to institution_directory in_scope.
checks.exclusions: Bounded to endowment reporters; not an all-ipeds_facts institution inventory.
checks.result: 1,109 reporters are served in scope; 265 are loaded but unserved: 61 absent from the directory and 204 directory out-of-scope.
checks.unfinished_reason: Original full-universe inventory remains unexecuted to avoid an unnecessary 4.4M-row transfer.

checks.name: finance sign contract by release
checks.method: Strictly page six endowment fields for FY2020–FY2024, stratify 30 release/field buckets, and compare value_numeric/value_text/value_label behavior with projector semantics.
checks.exclusions: Six endowment fields only; one release per year in the bounded result.
checks.result: Across five releases (four final, one provisional), 8,425 unlabeled negative values remain numeric; zero labeled negatives remain numeric. The evidence rejects a blanket allowNegative registry.

checks.name: residual/accounting and Scorecard reconciliation
checks.method: Evaluate the six-component F2 identity and draw-rate eligibility by reporter-year; run the existing no-fuzzy OPEID6 Scorecard reconciliation against the declared local input.
checks.exclusions: Scorecard gate excludes 31 in-scope rows without a complete F2 pair and 211 rows outside the current population definition.
checks.result: 6,645/6,653 reporter-years are draw-rate eligible; exclusions are three accounting mismatches and five nonpositive beginnings. FY2024 Scorecard reconciliation matches 1,085/1,085 reporting entities (1,066 direct; 19/19 consolidations), 97.222% population coverage, gate pass; fixtures 5/5.

checks.name: release identity/scoped loading/access fallback
checks.method: Inspect load_release release-date/collection-year validation, scoped upsert, fallback, and post-load direct-read gates; cross-check live release_id/type stratification.
checks.query_script_identifier: tools/ipeds/load_release.py static inspection + finance live slice
checks.exclusions: No new release package was available for an end-to-end dry-run; production mutation prohibited.
checks.result: The bounded slice has one explicit release identity per year and preserves final/provisional type. Source code retains scoped upsert and strict manifest identity gates.
checks.unfinished_reason: Next-release access-fallback dry-run remains an operational gate.

checks.name: finance provenance surfacing
checks.method: Check source_table/source_variable/release_type on every row in the bounded endowment slice; inspect school_facts_unified/API consumer fields.
checks.exclusions: Live completeness was bounded to six endowment fields, not every finance display group.
checks.result: Zero bounded rows lack source_table, source_variable, or release_type. Serving/API code exposes provenance, imputation, quality, and definition-alignment fields.
checks.confidence: high for bounded slice; moderate beyond it
checks.unfinished_reason: A query-specific all-finance-display-group provenance audit remains.

checks.name: cleaner label variants and near misses
checks.method: Run the complete existing Tier 4 cleaner unit suite and inspect label normalization/substr-map order.
checks.exclusions: No new corpus-derived fuzz/near-miss generator was created.
checks.result: All 87 cleaner tests pass, including existing gender and label variants. This is regression coverage, not a near-miss rate.
checks.confidence: high for tests; low for corpus miss rate
checks.unfinished_reason: Requires corpus-derived label candidates and reviewed expected mappings.

checks.name: OCR precision/ground truth
checks.method: Planned manual comparison of OCR-recovered tables against source-page ground truth.
checks.exclusions: No reviewed ground-truth set exists.
checks.result: Not executed; no precision or hallucination percentage is claimed.
checks.unfinished_reason: Requires manual data-review authority/time and a declared sample.

checks.name: format-sniff corpus audit
checks.method: Range-probe first 4 KiB of every current source; fully fetch and worker-sniff every ZIP; fully verify deterministic 100-PDF sample, all capped at 50 MiB.
checks.exclusions: 15 current source objects returned persistent probe errors and are explicitly listed rather than silently omitted.
checks.result: Observed 3,610 PDF, 389 ZIP, 56 HTML-within-512, one other; zero leading-junk PDFs and zero HTML markers after byte 512 within 4 KiB. All 389 ZIPs sniffed (370 XLSX, 19 DOCX), 28 stale declared-format labels, zero ZIP SHA mismatch/error. Byte sniff heals routing; no silent loss was demonstrated.

checks.name: producer-version discipline
checks.method: Enumerate Tier 4 version history, inspect Tier 6 cleaner dependency/idempotency key, and strictly query all Tier 6 canonical artifact notes.
checks.exclusions: Git sequence cannot prove same-commit discipline for every unenumerated cleaner edit.
checks.result: Tier 4 has sequential 0.3.0→0.3.14 bumps. Tier 6 calls the evolving Tier 4 cleaner but remains 0.1.0. All five current Tier 6 artifacts (four documents) lack source-SHA provenance, so they do not presently suppress a SHA-known redrain; after a SHA-tagged artifact is created, a cleaner-only change can be skipped unless Tier 6 version also bumps.

checks.name: selector/category/API suppression behavior
checks.method: Trace selector and public category/friendly-field behavior, then quantify admissions suppression against all browser rows.
checks.exclusions: Numerator/denominator covers the three admissions values across 558 rows; finance exposure is via school_facts_unified, not this friendly CDS path.
checks.result: Fifteen non-null admissions values are deliberately suppressed with an explicit low-confidence reason. No invisible finance suppression on the current IPEDS serving path was found.

checks.name: consumer finance and draw-rate semantics
checks.method: Trace draw-rate component/formula/status handling through projector, recipe, API documentation, and bounded live values.
checks.exclusions: Three accounting mismatches and five nonpositive beginning balances are explicit exclusions.
checks.result: Consumer contract uses abs(F2H03C)/F2H01, preserves raw F2H03D, and excludes contaminated derived rates without erasing raw components. Live p50 draw rate 4.005%, p95 10.503%.

checks.name: spreadsheet/structured/projection parity contract
checks.method: Compare source scopes and selectors before defining equality; reframe toward per-document selected artifact identity.
checks.exclusions: Historical download artifacts and current-year browser projection intentionally enumerate different populations.
checks.result: Exact artifact-set equality is an invalid invariant. The defensible contract is that every projected document records the exact selected artifact/source SHA and every download declares its scope; projections currently lack that identity, already captured under A4.
checks.unfinished_reason: Original check rejected as structurally invalid; reframed control is not yet representable by projection schema.
